verdict.rationale: AI Gateway supports failover across providers (order/only/sort, per-provider timeouts, automatic retries to other providers or system credentials) which mitigates a single provider's rate limits, and per-request BYOK credentials allow varying keys per call. However, there is no documented feature for spreading traffic across multiple keys for the same provider or for queuing/throttling requests to smooth rate limits — these are implied only via provider fallback, not explicit queue/throttle mechanisms. Missing for 10: explicit multi-key load balancing within a provider, request queuing, and throttling/backoff controls for rate-limit smoothing.
